# Statesu

> Statesu is an open-source Markdown CMS for adding a blog to an existing website. Write from the dashboard or CLI; display posts with a JavaScript embed or render them as HTML on your own domain using the public API.

The embed renders posts in the browser. For HTML with post content and metadata in the initial response, use server-side rendering or static export. Public API reads do not require a token; authoring and management do.

## Documentation

- [Web integration guide](https://statesu.com/docs/integration): Add the embed, configure allowed origins, or serve HTML on your own domain.
- [Static export walkthrough](https://statesu.com/docs/integration#static-export): Publish Markdown posts as HTML files alongside an existing site.
- [CLI guide](https://statesu.com/docs/cli): Install `stscli`, connect an account, and publish Markdown from the terminal.
- [API reference](https://statesu.com/docs/api): Manage blogs and posts, or read published content as JSON.

## Examples and source

- [Demo blog](https://statesu.com/demo/blog/): Example of a static HTML blog that works without JavaScript.
- [Blog renderer source](https://github.com/burak-s/statesu/blob/HEAD/web/examples/customer-blog.js): Reference implementation for server-side rendering and static export.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/burak-s/statesu): Code, license, and self-hosting instructions.
